FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A01
Anti-lock cars stomp and hold through clicks and shudders, while non-anti-lock cars follow the owner's manual instead [A01].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F02, sec09-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A01
Swerves steer around and counter-steer straight, while animal encounters brake and steer together [A01].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F04, sec09-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A01
Braking and steering dodge threats ahead, while accelerating dodges strikes from behind or the side [A01].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F01, sec09-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A02
Anti-lock skids take steady brake pressure, while plain skids take gentle pumps and never a stomp [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F08, sec09-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A02
Sideways skids steer into the sliding rear, then unwind fast to block the counter-skid [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F10, sec09-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A02
Injury scenes hold position until questioned, while non-injury wrecks shift to the shoulder [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F13 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A02
Driver-to-driver crashes log full identities and damage, while parked-car strikes leave a dated note [A02].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F14, sec09-F15 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A03
Collision reports e-file through the portal or mail to Frankfort, but never when an officer investigated [A03].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F17 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A03
Victims move only to save a life, otherwise awaiting the ambulance under blankets [A03].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F18 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A03
Dead brakes try the parking brake first, then the engine switch as the last resort [A03].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F21, sec09-F22 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A03
Front blowouts yank toward the burst side, while rear blowouts wobble, shake, and drift [A03].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F23 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec09-R12 | anchor: A04
Power failures brake steadily to the shoulder, while runaway accelerators switch off and grab neutral first [A04].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F26, sec09-F28 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec09-R13 | anchor: A04
Breakdowns shun crests and bends for parking, then plant flares 200 to 300 feet behind [A04].
Why it matters: group emergency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F29, sec09-F30 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0066]
